records.title: Reconciliation time reduction
records.subtitle: Harbor Tools
records.summary: Team result: Dispatch Loom reduced reconciliation time from 5 hours to 2 hours per week, measured over six weekly runs. Personal contribution was the parser and checks; coworkers also changed their checking habits. Delivery speed was not measured.
records.source_quote: Dispatch Loom reduced reconciliation time from 5 hours to 2 hours per week, measured over six weekly runs.

claims.value: Reconciliation time reduced from 5 hours to 2 hours per week over six weekly runs

evidence.quote: Dispatch Loom reduced reconciliation time from 5 hours to 2 hours per week, measured over six weekly runs. This was a team result; my contribution was the parser and checks.
I first said 50% time saved, but that was wrong.

claims.value: Personal contribution was the parser and checks

evidence.quote: This was a team result; my contribution was the parser and checks.

claims.value: Coworkers also changed their checking habits

evidence.quote: I cannot attribute all improvement to myself because coworkers also changed their checking habits.

claims.value: Earlier 50% time-saved figure was incorrect

evidence.quote: I first said 50% time saved, but that was wrong.

claims.value: The measured time was reconciliation time, not delivery time

evidence.quote: An earlier conversation mixed up delivery time and reconciliation time. Delivery speed was not measured. The six-run measurement describes reconciliation work only.

decisions.reason: The material facts are unchanged. The new denial that delivery speed was not measured is already entailed by the earlier scoped correction that the six-run measurement covered reconciliation time, not delivery time; the metric, team attribution, personal contribution, and other corrections also match.
